author: mark
text:
v0.3 layout migration complete

All seven phase balls landed: harness root + global providers split,
template skeleton on the new shape, branch + step namespacing,
soul/role machinery (with agents.yaml retired), compactor at
summary/<NNN>.md with merge=ours discipline, schema regen + final
string sweep, and make install harness root scaffold.

cargo test (422 tests across the workspace) and cargo tarpaulin
(100% line coverage) green on main. Scratch lernie new produces
the v0.3 conv-repo shape end-to-end: control files at conv-repo
root (manifest.yaml, workflow.yaml, providers.yaml, version,
souls/), root/ as the primary worktree with .git inside it, and
.gitattributes pinning goal.md/soul.md/summary/** to merge=ours.
No .agent/, no exchanges/, no invocations/, no agents.yaml left
in tree.

v0.3 layout is the foundation v0.3 tools (bl-683c) and v0.5 UI
(bl-c0a5) build on; v0.4 subagent dispatch unblocks once both
parent epics close.
